problem_statement: paginate() drops the last item of every page: paginate(list(range(10)), 1, 3) returns [0, 1] instead of [0, 1, 2].
patch:
--- a/listkit_page/__init__.py
+++ b/listkit_page/__init__.py
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 
 def paginate(items: list, page: int, per_page: int) -> list:
     start = (page - 1) * per_page
-    end = start + per_page - 1
+    end = start + per_page
     return items[start:end]
test_patch:
--- a/tests/test_listkit_page.py
+++ b/tests/test_listkit_page.py
@@ -7,3 +7,11 @@
 
 def test_page_past_the_end_is_empty():
     assert paginate(list(range(4)), 9, 3) == []
+
+
+def test_full_page():
+    assert paginate(list(range(10)), 1, 3) == [0, 1, 2]
+
+
+def test_last_page_is_short():
+    assert paginate(list(range(10)), 4, 3) == [9]
